keys.description: Manage API keys and choose the projects and operations each key can access.
keys.scopeHelp: Choose permissions for each project. Permissions are independent. No scopes means this key has no access.
keys.scopeRequired: Choose a project and at least one permission for each scope.
keys.duplicateProject: Combine permissions for the same project in one scope.
cert.emptyDomains: No domains yet. An administrator can add the first domain.
cert.emptyCertificates: Add a certificate policy to begin.
cert.policyHelp: Policies take effect after saving. Automatic renewal starts issuance for new policies. Cloud deployment uploads to the certificate library; SSH also installs files and can reload a service.
cert.delegationHelp: Add these CNAME records at your DNS provider once. Use DNS-only mode, without proxying or CNAME flattening. CertCenter publishes TXT challenges automatically for issuance and renewal.
cert.noDNSProviders: Ask an administrator to add an account on the DNS providers page, then refresh this page.
providers.name: Name
providers.updateResourcesHelp: Replace resources bound to earlier certificates uploaded by this policy. Initial resource binding is configured in the cloud console.
providers.deleteOldHelp: Requires resource updates. Delete old cloud certificates only after successful updates and a check for remaining bindings. Local certificate history is retained.
providers.contactIDsHelp: Required for Alibaba resource updates. Enter comma-separated contact IDs from Certificate Management Service. Deploying uploaded certificates requires available deployment quota.
providers.help: Saved accounts become available in certificate policies. Credentials are never returned. Accounts referenced by policies cannot be deleted.
providers.keepSecret: Leave blank to keep the stored credential. Enter a value to replace it.
providers.empty: No accounts configured. Add an account to begin.
providers.cloudflareHelp: Grant Zone / Zone / Read and Zone / DNS / Edit for the zones to manage.
providers.managedHelp: Built-in CNAME validation appears automatically once the administrator configures the public validation DNS zone. Domain owners only copy the CNAME shown on their domain page.
cert.delegationChecked: CNAME check completed. Results reflect the latest check.
settings.help: Edit and save settings here. ACME and registration changes apply to subsequent operations; other changes require a service restart.
settings.generalHelp: Listener, public URL, session lifetime and enabled languages take effect after restart.
settings.acmeHelp: New jobs use the saved authority and contact. Accept the selected authority’s terms before issuing.
settings.dnsHelp: Configure the public validation zone and nameserver here. Restart to activate it, and configure NS records and public UDP/TCP port 53. An empty zone disables it. Changing the zone requires updating existing CNAMEs.
settings.oauthHelp: Leave the secret blank to retain it. An empty callback uses the public URL plus /oauth/callback. Clear both issuer and client ID to disable OAuth after restart.
settings.accessHelp: Registration changes apply immediately. Group mappings apply after restart. Bootstrap administrator settings are used during startup initialization, and do not edit existing user accounts.
settings.databaseHelp: Leave the connection string blank to retain it. Changing the connection does not migrate data; prepare the target database and restart to switch.
settings.durationHelp: Use a Go duration, for example 24h or 30m.
settings.redirectHelp: Leave blank to derive it from the public URL.
settings.mappingHelp: One mapping per line: group=admin or group=user.
settings.savedRestart: Saved. Restart the service to apply pending settings.
settings.invalidMapping: Use one unique group=admin or group=user mapping per line.
settings.encryptionHelp: The stored encryption key is retained when saving settings. Changing it requires re-encrypting existing certificate material.
keys.domainScopeHelp: Choose domains and permissions. An empty scope list disables the key.
keys.domainDescription: Manage API keys and choose the domains and operations each key can access.
keys.domainScopeRequired: Choose a domain and at least one permission for each scope.
keys.duplicateDomain: Combine permissions for the same domain in one scope.
